settings.title: Set the mcpp executable path
settings.description: Path to the mcpp CLI used for every mcpp command. Leave it empty to look up mcpp on the PATH of the VS Code process.

settings.title: Limit project discovery scope
settings.description: How far the extension walks to find mcpp.toml. "filesystem" also searches outside the workspace folder; it costs more I/O and can reach unrelated trees.

settings.title: Clear the task terminal
settings.description: Clear the terminal before an mcpp task starts, so the last build's output is not mistaken for this one's.

settings.title: Add arguments to mcpp build
settings.description: Extra arguments appended to the mcpp build task. Applied on the next build.

settings.title: Add arguments to mcpp run
settings.description: Extra arguments appended to the mcpp run task. Applied on the next run.

settings.title: Add arguments to mcpp test
settings.description: Extra arguments appended to the mcpp test task. Applied on the next test run.

settings.title: Add arguments to mcpp clean
settings.description: Extra arguments appended to the mcpp clean task. Applied on the next clean.

settings.title: Confirm before cleaning
settings.description: Ask for confirmation before a clean task deletes the target directory of the project.

settings.title: Reveal the task terminal
settings.description: When an mcpp task brings the terminal panel to the front: always, only when the task fails, or never.

settings.title: Focus the task terminal
settings.description: Move keyboard focus to the terminal while an mcpp task runs. Off by default so editor focus is not taken away.

settings.title: Parse task problems
settings.description: Parse compiler output of the mcpp build and test tasks into the Problems panel.

settings.title: Show editor title buttons
settings.description: Show the Run and Test buttons in the editor title bar while the file belongs to an mcpp project.

settings.title: Show language-service entries in the menu
settings.description: Keep the C++ Modules actions in the mcpp quick menu. Turn off to leave the menu to mcpp's own commands.

settings.title: Confirm resetting the workspace cache
settings.description: Ask before running the C++ Modules reset, which discards this workspace's model cache and prepares it again. Turning this off removes the only warning before that happens.

settings.title: Refresh language service after build
settings.description: How mcpp-vscode tells the C++ Modules extension about a finished build: auto, a lightweight reload, a full restart, or nothing.

settings.title: Notify when the language service degrades
settings.description: Show a notification when the C++ Modules language service reports a degraded state.

settings.title: Read language service state
settings.description: Read status from the C++ Modules extension through the API it exposes for tests. Turning this off only hides status; it never changes mcppls itself.

settings.title: Set the state refresh interval
settings.description: Re-read the language service state every this many seconds. 0 disables the timer.

settings.title: Complete mcpp.toml keys
settings.description: Offer section, key and value completion while editing mcpp.toml. The old mcpp.tomlCompletion key still works as an alias.

settings.title: Show mcpp.toml hovers
settings.description: Show documentation for sections and keys when hovering in mcpp.toml.

settings.title: Navigate inside mcpp.toml
settings.description: Enable go-to-definition for workspace, path and feature references in mcpp.toml.

settings.title: Enable mcpp.toml diagnostics
settings.description: Turn all mcpp.toml validation on or off. Every rule keeps its own severity setting.

settings.title: Set syntax diagnostic severity
settings.description: Severity used for mcpp.toml syntax errors.

settings.title: Set unknown section severity
settings.description: Severity used for sections that mcpp does not recognise.

settings.title: Set unknown key severity
settings.description: Severity used for keys that mcpp does not recognise.

settings.title: Set plane separation severity
settings.description: Severity used when a key is written in the wrong mcpp.toml plane, such as a build key in the library plane.

settings.title: Set legacy key severity
settings.description: Severity used for pre-0.5 mcpp.toml keys that still work but should be migrated.

settings.title: Complete dependency versions
settings.description: Query the package index to complete dependency versions. Off by default because it needs network access.

settings.title: Set the index query timeout
settings.description: How long one package index query may run before it is abandoned and completion falls back to local data, in seconds.

settings.title: Enable build.mcpp intelligence
settings.description: Turn completion and hover support for build.mcpp on or off.

settings.title: Enable build.mcpp diagnostics
settings.description: Validate build.mcpp against the build API mcpp actually ships.

settings.title: Set build.mcpp diagnostic severity
settings.description: Severity used for build.mcpp diagnostics.

settings.title: Check imported modules
settings.description: Offer mcpp's own modules (std, std.compat, mcpp.*) in import completion. Hover still recognises them, and no import is ever reported missing, whichever way this is set.

settings.title: Offer build.mcpp snippets
settings.description: Offer snippet completions for the mcpp build script API.

settings.title: Show cache size in status bar
settings.description: Show the size of the mcpp global cache in the status bar. Off by default to keep the status bar quiet.

settings.title: Warn above a cache size
settings.description: Warn when the mcpp global cache grows past this many GiB. 0 disables the warning.

settings.title: Mark stale cache entries
settings.description: Treat cache entries that were not accessed for this many days as stale. 0 disables the age rule.

settings.title: Refresh the cache view automatically
settings.description: Re-read the cache statistics every this many seconds. 0 disables automatic refreshing.

settings.title: Estimate project artifact size
settings.description: Measure the target directory of the current project so the cache view can show its size.

settings.title: Show legacy cache entries
settings.description: Include cache entries written by older mcpp versions in the cache view and in cleaning.

settings.title: Set the default cleanup budget
settings.description: Default size budget for cache cleanup, in GiB. 0 asks for a budget on every run.

settings.title: Confirm large cache cleanup
settings.description: Require an extra confirmation when a cleanup would free more than this many GiB. 0 confirms every cleanup.

settings.title: Set the pruning age
settings.description: Default age in days used when pruning cache entries older than a threshold.

settings.title: Hide the mcpp view contents
settings.description: Turns every mcpp view off at once. The view contents disappear, so the container shows nothing; whether VS Code also removes the mcpp icon from the activity bar is up to VS Code itself, because an extension cannot mark its container as hidden-when-empty. Right-click the icon to hide it there.

settings.title: Show the project view
settings.description: Show the mcpp project view in the activity bar. Takes effect after the view container reloads.

settings.title: Show the mcpp library ecosystem view
settings.description: Show the view that browses the package index mcpp has already refreshed locally.

settings.title: Show the cache view
settings.description: Show the mcpp cache view in the activity bar. Takes effect after the view container reloads.

settings.title: Show the language-service block in the project view
settings.description: The C++ Modules state is folded into the project view's basic information. The collapsed row always shows a status icon, so a problem is visible without expanding it.

settings.title: Set cache list length
settings.description: How many entries the cache view lists per group.

settings.title: Set cache age buckets
settings.description: Age buckets used to group cache entries in the cache view, written as "1d", "7d" and so on.

settings.title: Path to a mcpp package index checkout
settings.description: Leave it empty to use the indexes under the mcpp home. The home is `$MCPP_HOME`, then `~/.mcpp`; when neither holds an index, the extension asks `mcpp self env --format json` where it is.

settings.title: Search every configured registry over the network
settings.description: The local index already lists every published package, so this is off by default. Turning it on also searches the other registries with `mcpp search`, which may use the network and can only be parsed on a best-effort basis.

settings.title: Confirm only destructive actions
settings.description: Use a modal dialogue only for actions that cannot be undone. Turning this off asks for confirmation more often, never less.

settings.title: Set the extension language
settings.description: Language for extension messages and panels. "auto" follows VS Code; command titles and settings labels always follow the VS Code display language.

settings.title: Show the mcpp status bar item
settings.description: Show the main mcpp status bar item.

settings.title: Show language service status
settings.description: Show the C++ Modules language service state in the mcpp status bar item. Off by default because mcppls already has its own status item.

settings.title: Highlight the mcpp status bar item
settings.description: VS Code accepts only two background colours for a status bar entry, "statusBarItem.warningBackground" and "statusBarItem.errorBackground", and it overrides the foreground so the text stays readable; any other colour is dropped. The mcpp item is plain by default; "warning" gives it the theme's amber chip and "error" its red one.

settings.title: Report successful operations
settings.description: How successful mcpp operations are reported: in the status bar only, as a toast, or not at all.

settings.title: Deduplicate notifications
settings.description: Suppress a repeated notification for this many minutes. 0 shows every notification.

settings.title: Choose number formatting
settings.description: Format byte sizes with binary units (KiB, MiB) or decimal units (KB, MB).

settings.title: Set the log level
settings.description: Amount of detail written to the mcpp output channel. Debug output is verbose.

settings.title: Run a self check at startup
settings.description: Run the environment self check on activation and write problems to the output channel. Off by default because it starts mcpp.

settings.title: Set the command timeout
settings.description: How long one mcpp CLI command may run before it is terminated, in seconds. 0 disables the timeout.

settings.title: Cap captured command output
settings.description: Maximum output captured for one mcpp command, in MiB. When output is truncated the tail is kept.

settings.title: Limit concurrent mcpp commands
settings.description: Whether the one-command-at-a-time rule applies to each project separately or to the whole window.
